description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AndroidLogcatView that manages the UI and logic for viewing Android logcat output within an IDE environment, including device selection, filtering, and console management.

classes.name: AndroidLogcatView
classes.description: An abstract class providing UI and logic for Android logcat viewing, including device management, filtering, and console display.

classes.name: AndroidLogConsole
classes.description: Inner class extending LogConsoleBase, representing the logcat console component with methods to activate and clear logs.

classes.name: MyLoggingReader

classes.name: MyRestartAction
classes.description: Inner class extending AnAction, providing functionality to restart logcat view.

classes.name: MyFilterSelectedClientAction
classes.description: Inner class extending ToggleAction, allowing toggling of logcat filtering to a selected process.

methods.description: Constructors initializing the logcat view with project and device context.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates the logcat view and applies current filters.

methods.description: Updates the log console based on the selected device.

methods.description: Compiles a filter configuration by name.
